story.titleZh: 维斯塔潘与红牛续约至2030年，结束未来猜测
story.summaryZh: 马克斯·维斯塔潘已与红牛车队签署新合同，将至少效力至2030年，从而结束了关于他未来的猜测。

story.originalTitle: Verstappen ends speculation over future by committing to Red Bull until 2030
story.summaryEn: Max Verstappen has signed a new deal with Red Bull which will keep him at the team until at least 2030, ending speculation about his future.
detailZh: 马克斯·维斯塔潘已与红牛签署新合同，将至少效力至2030年。
这位四届世界冠军的未来一直是激烈猜测的主题，因为车队近几个赛季的表现有所下滑。他去年险些未能赢得连续第五个冠军，本赛季至今也尚未赢得任何比赛。
尽管维斯塔潘五年前签署了一份直到2028年的长期合同，但有报道称他可能利用退出条款提前离开并加入竞争对手车队。维斯塔潘也一直是F1新规的坚定批评者，并表示这些规定可能导致他缩短职业生涯。
然而维斯塔潘已表示他打算在当前规则周期内继续留在该系列赛中。他的新合同在原合同基础上再增加两年，使他留在红牛直到2030年。
维斯塔潘的新合同在本周末他的主场比赛前宣布，这表明尽管自他上次签约以来许多高级车队成员流失，他对车队仍有信心。车队领队克里斯蒂安·霍纳去年离职，明星设计师阿德里安·纽维加入了阿斯顿·马丁，包括车队经理乔纳森·惠特利、策略师威尔·考特尼等关键人物也已离开。
维斯塔潘表示他“对续约感到非常高兴”。
“我们拥有最优秀的人才，我很兴奋能继续与大家一起努力，再次回到巅峰。这仍然是我们所有人一直努力追求的终极目标，并将继续追求。”
红牛在2015年通过其第二支车队（当时称为红牛二队）将维斯塔潘带入F1。他们在2016赛季第四场比赛后将他提拔至红牛，他随即为车队赢得首个大奖赛冠军，令人震惊。
“车队对我来说就像第二个家，我感到非常自在，”维斯塔潘说。“我来到车队时希望能赢得比赛。
“我们后来共同取得的成就简直太美好了，我们分享了许多不可思议的时刻，赢得了四个世界冠军。能继续与我一直效力的同一支车队一起走这段旅程真的很特别，也是我一直想做的事情。”
维斯塔潘表示，他对劳伦特·梅基斯领导下车队的方向感到满意。梅基斯去年接替霍纳担任车队领队。
“现在与劳伦特合作超过一年也很棒，”维斯塔潘说。“我看到了他对车队的清晰愿景。米尔顿凯恩斯的每个人都相信我们正在建设的东西，我期待下一章，为更多胜利而战，为冠军而竞争，同时继续塑造这支车队的未来。
“在赞德沃特最后一场大奖赛期间宣布这一消息对我来说也是一个伟大的时刻。希望我们能给车迷们一个特别的告别。”
梅基斯表示，维斯塔潘的新合同对红牛“以及整个F1和赛车运动”都是积极的。
detailEn: Max Verstappen has signed a new deal with Red Bull which will keep him at the team until at least 2030.

The four-times world champion’s future has been a subject of intense speculation as the team’s form has dipped in recent seasons. He narrowly failed to win a fifth consecutive championship last year and has not won a race so far this season.

Although Verstappen signed a long-term deal five years ago running until 2028, reports emerged indicating he could take advantage of an exit clause to leave early and join a rival team. Verstappen has also been a staunch critic of Formula 1’s new regulations and indicated they may lead him to shorten his career.

However Verstappen has indicated he intends to remain in the series through the current regulations cycle. His new deal adds a further two years onto his previous contract, keeping him at Red Bull until 2030.

Verstappen’s new contract, announced ahead of his home race this weekend, demonstrates his confidence in the team despite the loss of many senior team members since his last deal. Team principal Christian Horner left last year, star designer Adrian Newey joined Aston Martin and key players including team manager Jonathan Wheatley, strategist Will Courtenay and others have also left.
Verstappen said he is “really pleased with the contract extension.”

“We have the best people and I’m excited to keep working together with everyone to get back to the top again. This remains the ultimate goal that all of us have been working towards and will continue to pursue.”

Red Bull brought Verstappen into F1 in 2015 with its second team, then known as Toro Rosso. They promoted him to Red Bull four races into the 2016 season and he stunned by winning his first grand prix for the team.
“The team is like a second family for me and I feel very at home,” said Verstappen. “I came to the team hoping to be able to win races.

“What we went on to achieve together has been simply lovely and we have shared many incredible moments and won four world championships. To continue this journey with the same Team that I have been with my whole career is really special and something I have always wanted to do.”
Verstappen said he is pleased by the direction the team has taken under Laurent Mekies, who replaced Horner as team principal last year.

“Getting to work with Laurent now for over a year has also been great,” said Verstappen. “I see a clear vision he has for the team. Everyone in Milton Keynes believes in what we are building and I am looking forward to the next chapter, fighting for more victories and competing for championships as we continue to shape the future of this team.
“To make this announcement during the last grand prix at Zandvoort is a great moment for me as well. Hopefully we can give the fans a special send-off for the final race.”
Mekies said Verstappen’s new contract was positive for Red Bull “as well as F1 and motorsport as a whole.”
keyPointsZh: 新合同在维斯塔潘的主场比赛周末前宣布，将原合同延长两年。
尽管红牛自其上次签约以来流失了多位高级成员，包括车队领队克里斯蒂安·霍纳、设计师阿德里安·纽维等，维斯塔潘仍对车队表示信心。
维斯塔潘表示对劳伦特·梅基斯领导下的车队方向感到满意，并称车队像第二个家。
keyPointsEn: The new contract was announced ahead of his home race weekend and adds two years to his previous deal.
Despite Red Bull losing several senior members since his last deal, including team principal Christian Horner and designer Adrian Newey, Verstappen expressed confidence in the team.
Verstappen said he is pleased with the team's direction under Laurent Mekies and described the team as like a second family.

relatedItems.originalTitle: Colton Herta “maybe underestimated the difference” from IndyCar – F2 boss
detailZh: F2总监：赫塔可能低估了F1和IndyCar之间的差距
布鲁诺·米歇尔建议，赫塔在转向F2的过程中遇到了比他预期的更大的困难，但他希望这位美国车手能够反弹。
F2首席执行官布鲁诺·米歇尔表示，赫塔可能低估了F1的二级系列和IndyCar之间的差距，这位26岁的车手的勇敢职业转变至今尚未成功。
赫塔在美国顶级单座赛车系列中一直是领跑者，但决定在2026年回到欧洲——在2015年和2016年参加了跨大西洋的青训车队比赛——以追求他的F1梦想。
在凯迪拉克的F1新车队中获得了测试和开发角色后，赫塔被分配了掌握F2的任务，以便为可能的世界锦标赛晋升做准备。
然而，他在F1的二级系列赛中的首个赛季结果远低于预期。这位加利福尼亚人目前在车手积分榜上排名第19，而且他在整个赛季中的表现水平实际上有所下降——这让他感到困惑——几起事故加剧了他的问题。
“这比我想的要困难得多，因为科尔顿是一个非常强的车手，这一点毫无疑问，”米歇尔评论道。
“他和我们可能低估了我们与IndyCar车队相比的工作环境差异，但我不认为这必须成为一个例子，我真心希望他能够以高水平结束本赛季。我们仍然在为此希望。”
法国人指出，F2复杂的周末赛制，仅有45分钟的自由练习和30分钟的排位赛，可能是赫塔表现不佳的原因之一。
他也有一些不错的比赛，但在排位赛中遇到了更多困难，也许这也是我们遇到的限制之一，因为在30分钟内你需要找到正确的时机[进行你的跑圈]，你只有两次在轮胎上的飞驰圈数，而你在这段有限的时间内几乎没有赛道时间，”米歇尔说。
这也是我们为F1培养车手的方式，因为你知道在F1中你也有有限的赛道时间。
所以，他可能为此而挣扎，并且比他预期的承受了更多的痛苦。现在我真的希望，真诚地希望，他能够以高姿态结束本赛季——他应得的。
赫塔本人对自己的赛季剩余比赛感到不确定，因为卡塔尔和阿布扎比的比赛因伊朗战争而受到威胁，然而米歇尔重申这些赛事“不会取消”。
至于赫塔的未来，Hitech车手明确表示他对第二个F2赛季“没有兴趣”，但他不会排除这种情况，如果凯迪拉克希望他为车队效力。
detailEn: Colton Herta “maybe underestimated the difference” from IndyCar – F2 boss
Bruno Michel suggests Colton Herta struggled “more than what he expected” on his switch to F2 but hopes the American can bounce back
Formula 2 CEO Bruno Michel says Colton Herta “maybe underestimated the difference” between Formula 1’s feeder series and IndyCar, with the 26-year-old’s bold career move so far unsuccessful.

Herta was a frontrunner in America’s premier single-seater series for seven years but decided to move back to Europe in 2026 – having competed in junior formulae across the pond in 2015 and 2016 – in order to chase his F1 dream.
Having landed a test and development role with Cadillac’s nascent F1 team, Herta was tasked with mastering F2 in order to prepare for a potential graduation to the world championship.

However, his maiden season in F1’s feeder series has ended up well below expectations. The Californian lies 19th in the drivers’ standings, and his performance level has actually worsened throughout the year – which he has been at a loss to explain – with several crashes compounding his issues.
“It's been more difficult than what I thought it was going to be, because Colton is a very strong driver, there's no doubt about that,” Michel commented.

“He and we maybe underestimated the difference of working environment that we had compared to IndyCar teams, but I don't think it has to be settled as an example, and I really hope that he's going to finish the season in a high. We're still hoping for that.”
The Frenchman pointed to F2’s tricky weekend format, with just a 45-minute free practice session and a 30-minute qualifying round ahead of the two races, as a potential cause for Herta’s struggle.

“He had some good races as well, he had more difficulties in quali, and maybe also that's one of the limits that we were having, because in 30 minutes you come up with the right timing [for your runs], you have two flying laps on sets of tyres on which you have very limited track time,” Michel said.
“That's also the way we prepare drivers for Formula 1, because you know in Formula 1 that you have limited track time as well.
“So, probably he struggled for that and he suffered from that a bit more than what he expected. Now I really hope, sincerely, that he's going to finish the season on a high – he deserves it.”

Herta himself was unsure he was going to get any more races to finish the season given the Qatar and Abu Dhabi rounds are known to be at threat due to the Iran war, however Michel reaffirmed these events “will not be cancelled”.
As for Herta’s future, the Hitech driver made it clear that he had “no interest” in a sophomore F2 season, but he won’t rule it out in case that’s what Cadillac wants for him.

赫塔在2015年和2016年参加了跨大西洋的青训车队比赛。
keyPointsEn: Herta was a frontrunner in America’s premier single-seater series for seven years but decided to move back to Europe in 2026.
Herta competed in junior formulae across the pond in 2015 and 2016.
